newsitem.title: USA: Norton sees Q2 loss, and $5.7 mln charge.
newsitem.headline: Norton sees Q2 loss, and $5.7 mln charge.

text.p: Norton Mcnaughton Inc said Tuesday that it expected to post a loss of betwen $0.02 and $0.04 per share in the second quarter, ended May 3, versus a loss of $0.09 per share in the year-earlier period.
In March, the company had forecast that it would break-even in the second quarter.
Norton also said that those losses would exclude a one-time pretax charge in the second quarter of $5.7 million.

That charge, said the company, reflects severance payments resulting from management changes, the termination of certain lease obligations and the establishment of reserves for certain contingencies, including the possible closing of the Norty's retail stores.
These changes, said Norton, are expected to result in an annualized cost savings in excess of $1.2 million.

Net sales for the second quarter, said the company, are expected to be in line with expectations, or approximately $53.2 million, compared to $57.4 million reported during last year's second quarter. The company said it expects to report its second quarter results during the week of June 2nd.
